title: Chris's reaction to anomalous metal, and only two others seen before

tellings.quote: He told me there were only he'd only ever seen two other reactions.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man said to attract UFOs, says that when he reacted to a piece of strange metal in Zanesville, Ohio, a NASA man named Timothy Taylor told him he had only ever seen two other people react that way. Bledsoe tells this himself, repeating Taylor's words, as a sign that something about him is unusual.
